Join over 3 million riders and experience the ultimate motorcycle navigation with calimoto!

Are you looking for an app to make your motorcycle ride even curvier and more exciting? Start your adventure now! With calimoto, you can plan your journeys, enjoy precision motorcycle navigation, save every road trip via GPS tracking, and get inspired by the riding community.

Whether you are cruising through the canyons or exploring local backroads: Our unique algorithm ensures every route is even curvier than you thought possible. We provide specialized scenic motorcycle navigation that loves twists and turns while avoiding boring highways.

APPLE CARPLAY INTEGRATION
Experience your GPS navigation directly on your bike's display! With full CarPlay integration, you have your motorcycle routes and the route planner right in your line of sight. It is the perfect extension for your cockpit, allowing you to focus on the road while following your trip planner.

WHY CALIMOTO IS THE NO. 1 CHOICE FOR EVERY MOTORCYCLE RIDE:
1. Individual Route Planner: Create your motorcycle routes as curvier as you like – directly in the app or via the web.
2. Turn-by-Turn GPS Navigation: Clear voice instructions for your navigation, so you can keep your eyes on the road.
3. Points of Interest (POIs): Your motorcycle GPS leads you directly to gas stations, restaurants, and famous biker hangouts.
4. GPX Feature: Import external motorcycle routes from other apps or use calimoto as your primary route planner for exports.
5. Offline Maps: Reliable GPS navigation and precise tracking even without an internet connection in remote areas.

MAXIMUM FUN FOR EVERY MOTORCYCLE ADVENTURE
No matter what motorbike you ride: Activate the tracker to analyze data like lean angle and acceleration after every road trip. Our specialized navigation is more than just a simple motorcycle app – it is your digital companion for a true moto feeling. Make your next outing even more scenic with our route planner, discover hidden twisties, and share your highlights in the community.

UPGRADE TO PREMIUM FOR THE ULTIMATE NAVIGATION
Take your scenic motorcycle navigation to the next level:
Worldwide offline maps and unlimited motorcycle routes
GPS navigation with speed limits and hazard warnings
Professional analysis for your motorcycle: lean angle and acceleration data

Download the calimoto app today! Turn every journey into a scenic adventure with the most advanced motorcycle route planner and GPS navigation available.

Privacy Policy: https://calimoto.com/en/information/privacy-policy

results.releaseNotes:
We ship new features, improvements, and fixes regularly. Keep auto-update on so you never miss what's next. Here's what's new in this release:

NEW FEATURES:
- Home Screen and Planner UI design update
- Default rerouting behaviour now more as generally expected: 
    - Less strict in considering a waypoint as reached (you don’t have to get as close to it)
    - Added a ‘Skip Radius’ for auto-skipping via points (only via points in the skip radius will be automatically skipped)
    - Default behaviour is now auto-skip waypoint within skip radius after 3 recalculations
- Added setting to switch to shorter verbal instructions (Settings > Sound & Voice Instruction)
- Added options to delete search term history and recent destinations

 BUG FIXES:
- Stability improvements
- Decreased possibility of route taking offramp only to take onramp again
- Fix for color picker being unresponsive when saving a new location by long-pressing on the map
- On CarPlay the icons in the focussed (selected) map button were not readable
- Some voice instruction changes for Hungarian
- Fix for sometimes not being able to scroll all the way up again on iPad in My Routes/My Rides/My Locations. 
- Fix for temporarily not having guidance instruction (visual and audible) after transferring navigation to CarPlay
- Fix for unreached waypoints being greyed out after editing a route during navigation
- Fix for old, already reached, waypoints being reinstated after editing a route during navigation
- Fix for map being stuck at certain rotation angle (not rotating with riding direction) after transferring to CarPlay after editing a route during navigation
- Folder count sometimes wrapping number to 2 lines if it goes into 3 digits
- Debug menu section is now revealed above the version number
- Fix for changes to an existing route sometimes not being saved persistently
- Fix for road closures and traffic incidents not showing on the map
- Doubled character limit for Ride descriptions from 2000 to 4000
- Fix for “Guide back to route” button not working on CarPlay
- Fix for ‘sticky’ route name when importing several routes from a single GPX sequentially

MileLogger — Drive. Track. Deduct.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
  The only mileage tracker that's 100% free, forever. No subscription. No account. No data sent anywhere. Just open the app and drive.

  Every mile you drive for work is worth $0.725 in tax deductions in 2026 — MileLogger makes sure you never miss one.

  ---
  FREE. FOREVER. NO CATCHES.

  No free tier that locks you out. No trial that expires. No "upgrade to unlock" — every feature is available to every user, always. We believe your mileage data belongs to you, not a subscription service.

  ---
  HOW IT WORKS
  - Drive — MileLogger detects your trip automatically in the background
  - Classify — swipe left for Personal, right for Business (or set Work Hours to auto-classify)
  - Report — view your mileage value by month or year, and export when tax season arrives

  That's it.

  ---
  KEY FEATURES

  Automatic Trip Detection
  Starts and stops recording the moment you drive — no tapping, no forgetting. Runs silently in the background.

  Smart Auto-Classification
  Set your work schedule once. MileLogger automatically marks drives during work hours as Business and drives outside as Personal — hands-free.

  2026 IRS Rate Built In
  Every business mile is calculated at the current IRS standard rate of $0.725/mile. Always up to date.

  Detailed Reports
  Monthly and yearly summaries show your total miles, trip count, and tax deduction value at a glance. Export a full CSV report to share with your accountant in one tap.

  No Account Required
  Open the app and go. No email. No password. No sign-up screen. Nothing.

  Your Data Stays on Your Device
  All trips and settings are stored locally on your iPhone. Nothing is sent to any server. Backup to your personal iCloud — only you can access it.

  Named Locations & Custom Purposes
  Label your home, office, and frequent stops. Tag trips with custom purposes for cleaner records and audit-ready logs.

  Vehicle Management
  Track mileage across multiple vehicles separately.

  ---
   WHO IT'S FOR
  - Freelancers and independent contractors
  - Delivery and rideshare drivers (Uber, Lyft, DoorDash)
  - Real estate agents and sales professionals
  - Small business owners and self-employed professionals
  - Anyone who drives for work and wants the deduction

  ---
   PRIVACY FIRST

  We don't have your data because we never asked for it. No account means no breach. No server means no leak. Your trip history lives on your phone and your iCloud — period.

  ---
   ICLOUD BACKUP

  Back up your entire trip history to iCloud with one tap. Restore it just as easily. Your data follows you when you get a new phone — no account migration, no CSV import, no hassle.

  ---
  Stop paying monthly for something that should be free.
  Download MileLogger and keep every dollar you've earned on the road

results.description:
Looking for an all-in-one motorcycle app that can help you plan your next trip and ensure your safety on the road? Look no further than Detecht! Whether you're a experienced rider or just starting out, Detecht has got you covered. With a range of features designed specifically for motorcyclists, Detecht is the ultimate app to help you stay safe, plan & navigate your routes, and connect with other riders.

The #1 app for people who love riding.

Safety Comes First

One of the most important features of Detecht is its safety tools. With automatic crash detection, safety tracking, and hazard warnings, you can ride with confidence, knowing that Detecht is always looking out for you. Our Automatic Crash Detection system will alert your emergency contacts in the event of an accident, while Safety Tracking keeps you connected to your loved ones with real-time location sharing. Our Hazard Warnings system will notify you of any potential hazards along your route, so you can stay alert and avoid accidents.

Plan Your Next Adventure

With Detecht's Route Planning features, you can create and navigate the perfect trip with just a few taps. Whether you're looking for curvy routes or round trips, Detecht has got you covered. Our planning tool makes it easy to customize your trip based on your preferences with stops, waypoints, and more. You can also explore over 250,000 user tracked routes to find the one that's right for you. The app allows you to plan your route in advance and ride it with our turn-by-turn GPS navigation and voice guidance, so you can focus on enjoying the ride when you're on the road. 

Connect with Other Riders

Detecht's motorbike community is a great way to connect with other riders. Our Social Feed lets you find riding buddies, share your experiences, and stay up to date on the latest news and trends. Take part in the discussions, chat with fellow riders, share routes, and plan your next adventure together.

Other Handy Features

In addition to the safety, route planning, and community features, Detecht also offers other handy tools for motorcyclists. The app supports GPX file formats, making it easy to import and export routes, while the ride statistics feature lets you track your progress and see how far you've come. These tools are perfect for serious riders who want to keep track of their progress and see how they're improving over time.

In summary, Detecht is the ultimate mobile app for motorcyclists, offering a range of features that cater to the needs of all riders. Whether you're a seasoned rider or just starting out, Detecht is the app you need to take your riding to the next level.

Detecht premium is available as an optional upgrade with three different periods, 1 month, 6 months and 12 months. You can subscribe and pay through your App Store account. Your subscription will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage your subscriptions by entering the user settings in your App Store account after the purchase.

Terms of use: https://detechtapp.com/terms-of-use
Privacy policy: https://detechtapp.com/privacy-policy

Unlock the full potential of your motorcycle moments — before, during, and after every ride with Cardo Ride!

Cardo Ride is part of the Cardo family, built to create a complete ecosystem for the ultimate motorcycle experience. From planning epic routes to riding together and reliving your adventures, Cardo Ride enhances every moment on and off the bike.

Cardo Ride is your motorcycle companion, designed to elevate every ride and connect riders across the globe. Our vision is to seamlessly transform your motorcycle routes and memories into shareable adventures, enabling you to make the most out of every moment spent with your bike.

Join the global Cardo Ride community and be part of this extraordinary journey of navigation, riding, and shared motorcycle adventures!

ADVENTURE ROUTING

Discover and conquer the finest routes worldwide, customized to your preferences. Cardo Ride’s intelligent algorithms, combined with community sourced insights and curvy road detection, ensure unparalleled riding experiences — from scenic rides to demanding tours.

PACK RIDE

Effortlessly organize group rides and receive real time notifications — for example, if someone falls behind, if you want to warn your Pack, or if you need a break.
Please note: For unlimited Pack Ride access (beyond 30 minutes), the Pack Leader must be a Cardo Ride PRO member.

TRACKING

Cardo Ride tracks your rides and stores them in your personal roadbook. Add your photos, explore detailed ride statistics, and share your adventures whenever you want.

NEWSFEED & FOLLOWERS

Stay inspired by following fellow riders’ activities, connect with friends, and share your best two wheeled moments.

GETAWAYS

Plan exciting trips with your friends or meet new riding companions through Getaways. Unite with the global Cardo Ride community and expand your riding circle.

AMBASSADORS

Discover Cardo Ride Ambassadors. Connect with experts through the Cardo Ride app, the Cardo Ride Journal, and our social media channels for exclusive tips and insights.

Upgrade to Cardo Ride PRO to unlock:

•  UNLIMITED PACK RIDE – Ride together, stay together  
•  SUPER CURVY ROUTING – Use your personal preferences to discover super curvy motorcycle routes  
•  LIVE TRACKING – Share your live location via a public tracking link  
•  OFFLINE MAPS – Track your rides even in the most remote areas

•  TOUR EXPORT – Export your recorded rides as GPX files

Ready to transform your motorcycle adventures?

Say goodbye to tedious paper mileage logs with the most accurate automatic mileage tracker. Track mileage effortlessly and create IRS-compliant logs for tax deductions or mileage reimbursements.

◉ IF YOU DRIVE FOR WORK DRIVERSNOTE IS FOR YOU
Driversnote is built for employees, self-employed professionals, and businesses who need accurate mileage tracking. Whether you're a healthcare worker, salesperson, real estate agent, construction professional, plumber, carpenter, delivery driver, small business owner, or part of a fleet, Driversnote helps you log every mile and maximize your reimbursement or tax deductions.

◉ STAY IRS-COMPLIANT & AUDIT-READY
Effortlessly generate tax-compliant mileage logs for your tax return or reimbursement claims. Your records are securely stored and accessible anytime, so you're always prepared in case of an audit.

◉ CLAIM YOUR TIME BACK
Our mile tracker saves you hours of manual logging. The app records all the information you need in real time, whether you're driving between clients, job sites, patients, or properties.
All in just 3 simple steps: Track, Categorize, and Report.

► TRACK

※ Track trips completely automatically - the simple mileage tracker starts tracking once you reach a certain speed.
※ Want to record an individual trip? Just tap START and STOP, and let our automatic GPS mile tracker handle the rest.
※ Easily log odometer readings for full mileage accuracy
※ Track miles for multiple vehicles and workplaces, clients and jobs

► CATEGORIZE

※ Categorize each trip as Business, Personal, Medical or Charity for a complete mileage log
※ Set working hours for automatic classification of business and personal trips
※ Add notes and tags to your recorded journeys for better documentation

► REPORT

※ Generate IRS-compliant mileage reports for reimbursement or tax deductions
※ Use the percentage split to report work vs personal driving when using the actual expenses method
※ Create separate mileage logs for multiple vehicles and workplaces
※ Export your vehicle logbooks as PDF or Excel, or send them directly

※ Customize your reimbursement rate if it differs from the IRS rate
※ Set reporting reminders so you never forget to log or report mileage
※ Save frequently visited addresses for faster trip creation

※ Advanced filtering for location, time period, and vehicle
※ Split trips, change details and add notes to multiple drives in seconds

※ Invite and remove users as you need
※ Employees track mileage automatically

※ Managers review and approve reimbursement claims in one simple overview

► PRIVACY BY DESIGN

※ We never sell your data
※ Your information is never shared with third parties for marketing

► SUPPORT

※ Our support team is ready to assist you at any time at support@driversnote.com

For the date range you can select a start and/or end date or choose from these shortcuts: This Week, Last Week, This Month, Last Month, Month To Date, Year To Date, Last 2 Months, Last 3 Months, Last 6 Months, Last 9 Months, Last 12 Months, This Year or Last Year.

Supports multiple client tracking which includes trip sorting and total mileage reporting for each client

Supports tracking these expenses: general, parking, tolls, meals, lodging, business center, conference, telephone, incidentals, other, gas and per diem. You can even provide notes specific to expenses and you can sort your trips by any of the expense columns.

Supports multiple driver tracking and includes trip sorting and total mileage reporting for each driver. Additionally, for all drivers easily export a report of total trips, total miles, average miles per trip and total vehicles driven.

Supports mileage type categorizing and includes trip sorting and total mileage reporting for each mileage type. For convenience, business, charitable, medical/moving and personal mileage types are automatically created but you can customize the list. Additionally, for all mileage types easily export a report of total trips, total miles, average miles per trip, total drivers and total vehicles driven. 

Supports multiple vehicle tracking and includes trip sorting and total mileage reporting for each vehicle. Additionally, for all vehicles easily export a report of total trips, total miles, average miles per trip and total drivers. You can also setup your own vehicle safety checklist and be prompted once per day to perform the checks.

Choose the statuses that meet your needs (i.e. Submitted, Claimed, etc.) and sort trips and get total mileage reporting for each status

Several user defined preferences available to allow you to customize the app to meet your needs 

Customizable calculation of cost per mile or kilometer with support for up to 3 decimal places 

Get total mileage and reimbursement reports by business, client, destination, driver, mileage type, origin, purpose, status, vehicle or year and month.

Flexibility to enter the odometer start/stop and have the distance calculated automatically or enter the distance manually

results.description:
Discover the curviest motorcycle routes and experience beautiful round trips with the individual route planning of Kurviger. Ride your route easily with the voice-guided navigation. Extend your tour with many motorcycle-friendly destinations such as hotels, biker meeting points and gas stations. Turn your motorcycle tour into an unforgettable experience. That and much more - with Kurviger!

Kurviger's feature highlights:
- Kurviger route planning with individual customizability
- Voice-guided navigation and offline maps
- Generate exciting round trips
- Transfer your routes in many formats
- Kurviger cloud synchronization
- Many motorcycle-friendly POIs
- Navigation with Apple CarPlay

Curvy route planning - route planning made easy!:
- Plan your individual motorcycle route and adapt it to your preferences. Set a starting point and your destination, the curve algorithm of Kurviger connects the points with the most beautiful roads and scenic passes.
- Add as many stopovers to your route as you like to customize your tour.
- Adjust the curviness of your route or exclude certain road types such as highways or toll roads.
- Learn important information about your route in advance, such as closures or unpaved roads.

Voice Guided Navigation - Available Everywhere:
- Kurviger offers you voice-guided navigation that guides you safely and reliably to your destination - anywhere in the world!
- Use offline maps and manage them easily in Kurviger's handy Offline Map Manager, so even a with no phone reception zone can't stop you.

Route Transfer - Easier than ever before:
- Load routes from a variety of sources supported including .gpx and .itn files.
- Easily share your route with your friends or transfer your route to your navigation device using many different formats including .gpx, .itn and .kml.

Discover the Kurviger Cloud - your routes always safely stored:
- You have the option to also plan your route on the Kurviger website and save it in the Kurviger Cloud.
- In the Kurviger Cloud, your route is stored securely and you can open it from any device - no external tools required!


POIs - Discover Motorcycle Friendly Destinations:
- A beautiful tour becomes a perfect tour with beautiful stops: With Kurviger
you can add breathtaking viewpoints, inviting biker hangouts, selected motorcycle hotels and much more to your route.
- Integrate other useful POI's, such as gas stations and garages into your route.
- Get inspired by exciting tour suggestions.

Kurviger Tourer and Tourer+ - The Ultimate Experience:
With our premium options, Kurviger Tourer and Tourer+ we offer the opportunity to take your experience with Kurviger to a whole new level! With Tourer+ you get access to all the premium features, like offline maps, trip recording, and of course our voice guided navigation.

Become a part of the community and make your next motorcycle tour a great experience with Kurviger.
